description:
aplicANT is the final editing and export step for professional job application documents in ChatGPT.

After discussing or preparing a resume in ChatGPT, aplicANT opens the information in an embedded editor. Users can review and edit personal details, work experience, education, skills, languages, projects, references and cover letters before creating the final document.

The editor includes:

• 50 professional resume templates
• Custom colors, fonts and layouts
• Editable and sortable resume sections
• Support for multiple document languages
• Optional profile pictures
• Integrated spelling assistance
• Resume and cover-letter previews
• Direct PDF rendering and download

aplicANT gives users full control over their application documents before export. It does not automatically send applications or contact employers.
